item.summary: fix(embedded-runner): flush partial streaming output before run budget abort (#116253) Preserve visible streamed assistant text when the hard run budget expires. Drain queued stream events before terminal-owned salvage while keeping cancellations and provider failures non-salvaging. Co-authored-by: SunnyShu0925 Co-authored-by: Ayaan Zaidi
